steps.text: You woke up with a turtle shell on your back! Someone in the Secret Gardens might know why.
The little lake turtles want to choose their own shells. Find them three: a teacup, a bucket and a flower pot.
checklist: A big teacup, at the south end of the Market
A flower pot, by the greenhouse

steps.text: Take the shells to the three little turtles on the lake shore, and let them choose.
Go back to the Wizard Lizard in the Secret Gardens.

reward.message: The Turtle Shell is yours to keep (find it in the wardrobe). +10 sparkles.
